chunks.text:
[The Long Dusk]
{hushed: a single bell and soft harp state the opening of the hometown melody in A minor, wistful and remembering the long night, then a rising swell into the light}
positive_styles: A minor resolving to A major
warm soft pulse-wave lead singing the hometown melody
bright celesta and bell melody sung out
gentle festive drums with soft snare
emotional swelling celebration, warm and triumphant but a touch bittersweet, lanterns relit in the night sky

chunks.text:
[The Light Catches]
{the same melody blooms in radiant A major on the warm lead over swelling strings and harp arpeggios — warmth returning, the stars relit}
